Keywords: freeze, hang, blocking, thread, qthread, async
Description: Long work on the GUI thread freezes the whole window
Do: Move I/O/CPU work to a QThread/worker or QtConcurrent; update UI via signals
Don't: Run network/file/DB calls directly in a slot on the main thread

Description: Icon-only buttons and custom widgets have no name for screen readers
Don't: Ship icon-only controls with no accessible name or tooltip

Description: Users who navigate by keyboard can't see where focus is
Do: Keep a visible :focus style (2px outline); ensure logical tab order
Don't: Remove focus rings or set tab order randomly

Keywords: color blind, status, red green, contrast
Description: Conveying state with color alone fails color-blind users
Do: Pair color with icon/text/shape (up arrow + green)
Don't: Use only red/green to show gain/loss or error/ok

Keywords: contrast, wcag, readability, gray on gray
Description: Body text below 4.5:1 is hard to read
Do: Verify text >=4.5:1 (large >=3:1) in BOTH light and dark
Don't: Light gray text on white surfaces

Keywords: hidpi, high dpi, scaling, blurry, retina, 4k
Do: Use SVG icons + @2x assets; size in points not pixels
Don't: Hardcode pixel sizes and ship single-resolution PNGs

Description: Buttons that trigger slow work give no feedback
Do: Disable the button + show BusyIndicator/progress during async ops
Don't: Leave the button enabled with no indication work started

Keywords: theme, dark mode, qpalette, tokens, hardcoded
Description: Per-widget hex breaks dark mode and theming
Do: Centralize a QSS theme + QPalette; reference one source of truth
Don't: Scatter raw hex across widgets and dialogs

Description: Default light QPalette flashes before QSS applies
Do: Set a dark QPalette AND QSS before showing the window
Don't: Apply only QSS and leave QPalette light

Description: Placeholder-only inputs lose their label on focus/typing
Do: Use a persistent QLabel (buddy) above/left of the field
Don't: Rely on placeholderText as the only label

Description: Errors shown only at top force users to hunt
Do: Show the error message next to the offending field on blur
Don't: Validate on every keystroke or only at submit-top

Description: Modal dialogs without Cancel/Esc trap the user
Do: Provide Cancel; Esc dismisses; Enter triggers default
Don't: Block the user with a modal that has no way out

Description: Nav that moves between screens disorients users
Do: Keep toolbar/sidebar placement identical across views
Don't: Reorder or relocate primary nav per page

Do: Min ~28-32px row/control height; 8px gaps between targets
Don't: Pack controls edge to edge with 2px gaps

Description: Long or layout-shifting animations feel cheap
Don't: Animate >400ms or animate layout geometry every frame
